DefaultDescription.defaultValue: Automated test ticket raised by the dev_tool Logic App to validate the CLOPSSEC_ticket_creation -> create_subtask building-block chain. Safe to close.

DefaultSubtaskDescription.defaultValue: Automated subtask raised by the dev_tool Logic App under the parent test ticket. Safe to close.

issue_type.description: Task | Problem | Incident (default: parameter DefaultIssueType = Incident). Sent to the ticket-creation block.

priority.description: Jira priority name or numeric id (default: parameter DefaultPriority = 10114, the lowest)

subtask_assignee.description: Optional Jira user name for the subtask; omitted = the subtask block's own default.

close_tickets.description: true (default: parameter CloseTickets = true): after creating them, walk the subtask and then the parent along close_path through the transition block. false: skip the close stage; the tickets stay open.

close_path.description: Statuses each ticket is walked through, in order (case-insensitive; default: parameter ClosePath = ["In Progress","Resolved","Closed"]). The last entry is the status both tickets must end in for a pass.

transition_field_values.description: Values for REQUIRED transition fields, keyed by Jira field id (e.g. resolution) or display name (e.g. Resolution); default: parameter TransitionFieldValues = {}. A required field with no value here gets the first allowed value Jira lists for it, unless Jira has a default for it; one without allowed values is left out and the block answers 400 (missing field).

targets.description: Per-run overrides of the building blocks under test. Omit to use the callback URLs baked in at deploy time; pass an INT or rebuilt block's trigger URL to point this run at it.

ticket_creation_url.description: HTTPS trigger callback URL of the ticket-creation block, SAS query string included.

create_subtask_url.description: HTTPS trigger callback URL of the subtask block, SAS query string included.

ticket_transition_url.description: HTTPS trigger callback URL of the ticket-transition block, SAS query string included. Only checked when the close stage runs.
